name: gtm.lead
description: Inbound/outbound lead triage for RIG. Routes by fit band, not by gut.

band.instructions: Buying readiness of this lead for a scoped AI delivery engagement
criteria: Student, hobbyist, or curiosity -- no budget and no named problem
Small team, interested, no named owner or timeline
Company with a named problem, an accountable owner, and a rough timeline
Named problem, owner, timeline, and an explicit budget or procurement path

fit.instructions: Which RIG motion fits this lead best

criteria.workflow_review: One accountable owner, one workflow, wants a scoped diagnostic
criteria.build: Wants something built or automated end to end
criteria.advisory: Wants judgment, governance, or fractional CAIO help
criteria.not_a_fit: Outside RIG's scope, a vendor pitch, or a job solicitation

is_vendor_pitch.instructions: This is someone selling to RIG rather than a prospective client

named_problem.instructions: The lead names a specific operational problem rather than a general interest in AI

rules.reason: inbound vendor pitch, not a lead
high-fit lead -- founder replies same day
